_about: Stroke descriptions for the Playwrite US Trad model. One entry per letter; add a letter the first time it is used, after checking its glyph (build_session.py prints measured heights). Keys: desc (required), trace=false (no dotted trace; model cells instead), dotted=true (glyph bounds include a dot, so skip the height hint).

i.desc: i: undercurve up to the x-height line, then retrace down the same line to a SHARP point at the top (no loop, or it reads as e); slant stroke down to the baseline; small undercurve out. Dot last.

t.desc: t: undercurve up past the x-height to about twice x-height, retrace the SAME line down to a sharp point (no loop, or it reads as l), slant stroke down to the baseline, small undercurve out. Cross-bar LAST: one flat stroke left to right at the x-height line, through the stem.

u.desc: u: two i-strokes joined; the second returns down to the baseline and exits with the undercurve. Pointed tops, parallel downstrokes.

w.desc: w: like u with one more bowl. Undercurve up to the x-height line, slant down to the baseline, undercurve up; again slant down, small undercurve; finish with a rising exit stroke to about x-height (it is what joins to the next letter). Pointed tops, parallel downstrokes. Unsure: the model font's w exit stroke may differ slightly from Palmer's.

r.desc: r: undercurve up, a small flat shoulder at the midline (a short level stroke, no loop), slant down to the baseline, small exit undercurve. Unsure: this font's r has a flat shoulder; Palmer-style r is often drawn with a small peak.

s.desc: s: undercurve up to a sharp point at the midline (same pointed top as i), slant down, small rounded base, exit. Keep it narrow. Unsure: the base of this font's s may differ from Palmer's.

e.desc: e: the height of u. Its top touches the dashed midline and never goes above it. Undercurve up, a small leaning loop, back down to the baseline and out. In this font e is about as wide as it is tall, and the loop is tiny (the model's hole is barely visible; do not stretch it upward to make room).

l.desc: l: its top touches the TOP line, twice the height of e. Undercurve up to the top line, a narrow loop, the downstroke crosses the upstroke near the midline, straight down to the baseline and out.
